result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off content card, truncated text, and layout overflow problems affecting the horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows a third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) that is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated mid-word
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped/sized so text isn't cut off, or add a fade/gradient overlay to indicate more content is scrollable

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, suggesting text overflow is not handled properly
issues.suggestion: Add text-overflow ellipsis or truncate with '...' to indicate more text exists

issues.description: The second promotional/restaurant image at the bottom (pizza image with -0% badge) is cut off by the navigation bar, showing incomplete information
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate padding/margin above the bottom navigation bar so content isn't obscured

issues.description: The discount badge shows '-0%' which is a nonsensical/placeholder value for a promotional badge
issues.suggestion: Replace with an actual discount percentage or remove the badge if no discount applies
